description: This file defines the FormFinder class within the Goteo\Util\Form namespace. It provides methods to set and get a form builder and model, and to instantiate form classes dynamically.

classes.name: FormFinder
classes.description: A utility class for managing form builders and models, and creating form instances dynamically.

methods.name: getBuilder
methods.description: Retrieves the current form builder object.

methods.name: setModel
methods.description: Sets the model data associated with the form.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of a form class, passing the builder, model, and options.
